title: The Tryout — A Short Story
description: A shy teenager gets a second chance to prove herself on the soccer field, one year after a mistake she never forgot.

scenes.narration: Maya sat on the bench, lacing up her cleats with shaking hands. Today was tryouts, and she had promised herself she wouldn't chicken out again.
scenes.visual: a teenage girl lacing up soccer cleats on a bench, focused and nervous expression, close-up

scenes.narration: Last year, she missed the easiest goal of the game, right in front of everyone. She still remembered the laughter. She never went back, until now.
scenes.visual: a teenage girl standing alone on a grassy field at dusk, head down, a soccer ball rolling away from her

scenes.narration: Her older sister sat beside her the night before. "Everyone falls, Maya," she said. "The only real mistake is not trying again."
scenes.visual: two teenage sisters sitting together on a porch step at sunset, one comforting the other with an arm around her shoulder

scenes.narration: So there she was, walking onto the field again, heart pounding, trying not to think about last year at all.
scenes.visual: a teenage girl running onto a green soccer field, other players warming up blurred in the background

scenes.narration: Five minutes in, she tripped chasing the ball and hit the grass hard. For a second, she wanted to disappear.
scenes.visual: a teenage girl falling while chasing a soccer ball on grass, motion blur, dramatic angle

scenes.narration: But her best friend on the sideline just laughed kindly and shouted, "Get up, superstar!" Maya couldn't help but laugh too, and she got back up.
scenes.visual: two teenage girls high-fiving on a sunny soccer field, big genuine smiles

scenes.narration: By the end of tryouts, she'd scored once and helped twice. When her name was called for the team, she screamed loud enough for the whole field to hear.
scenes.visual: a teenage girl jumping and cheering alone on a field at golden hour, arms raised in triumph

scenes.narration: Maya learned that the story doesn't end at the mistake. Follow along for a new story every day.
scenes.visual: two teenage friends laughing together while sitting on a park bench, warm evening light
